-1.event_info: Initial trigger for teacher-agent to pose questions in the classroom simulation

1.event_info: Teacher agent poses a question to all student agents

fields.name: question_content
fields.description: The content of the question posed by the teacher

fields.name: difficulty
fields.description: Difficulty level of the question (0-1 scale, where 0.5 is medium)

2.event_info: Teacher agent evaluates responses and allocates attention based on predefined criteria

fields.name: allocated_attention
fields.description: The amount of attention allocated to each student agent based on evaluation criteria.

fields.name: evaluation_criteria
fields.description: Criteria used by the Teacher Agent while evaluating student responses, such as communicative expression and socio-academic background.

fields.name: student_ids
fields.description: The list of student agent IDs that received attention.

3.event_info: Student agent provides a response to the teacher's question

fields.name: will_raise_hand
fields.description: Whether the student decided to raise their hand

fields.name: gesture_description
fields.description: Description of hand-raising gesture (if raised) or non-verbal state (if not raised)

fields.name: response_content
fields.description: The content of the response (empty if not raised)

fields.name: response_type
fields.description: Type of response (verbal if raised, non-verbal if not)

fields.name: student_id
fields.description: The identifier of the student agent
